constraints.constraint: Module must stay under 500 LOC to remain in single file. If exceeded, split to lib/ folder structure.
All heavy imports (pandas, plotly, ipywidgets) go in the module, not the notebook. Notebook should only contain widget displays and function calls.
Files must be named exactly: TIP_for_PATLIBs.ipynb and tip4patlibs_core.py (note underscores vs camelCase).
Do NOT import epo.tipdata.patstat yet - that's Story 1.2. This story only creates placeholders.
This is a greenfield project - no existing files to modify. Create all files fresh in project root directory.
Use __all__ to control what `import *` exposes from the module.
